en.title: Maintenance Rights in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: Maintenance is financial support that may be required under family law. The rules depend on who is asking, the relationship, the stage of the marriage or divorce, the needs of the person and the applicable law. There is no single amount that applies to every family.

atAGlance.whoFor: A spouse or parent wants to understand maintenance claims.
atAGlance.legalBasis: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961, section 9 where applicable; Family Courts Act, 2023; other applicable personal law.
atAGlance.mainRule: Section 9 addresses failure by a husband to maintain his wife adequately. Family-court jurisdiction is also important for family claims.
atAGlance.updateStatus: Do not publish a calculator or fixed percentage without a separately validated legal model.

en.lawMeaning: Section 9 addresses failure by a husband to maintain his wife adequately. Family-court jurisdiction is also important for family claims. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Save proof of earlier payments or non-payment.
Make a clear written request where appropriate.
Use the lawful family-court or other statutory route if agreement fails.
Keep child needs separate from adult claims.
evidence: Marriage record; child documents; income evidence; school/medical/food/housing costs; bank records; messages; prior orders.
en.simpleExample: A parent asks, “How much maintenance will the court give?” Justor should not guess a number. The amount depends on evidence, needs, means and applicable law.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: Using a social-media fixed rate.
